events.description: Welcome to a world of video created by junior high students! Expressive music videos and two dramas will captivate you. Please visit the AV Room.

events.description: Enjoy beautiful choral singing! We'll perform a wide range of genres, from choral pieces to J-POP. Please come to the AV Room!

events.title: Kotonohana
events.description: Enjoy the beautiful sounds of the koto, a traditional Japanese instrument, performed by the Koto Club. Each member will put their heart into the performance.

events.description: The culmination of 5 months of work by around 140 members. With the theme “Epilogue,” a special dance performance closing one chapter of the club's story.

events.title: 「Mata, Tonari de」
events.description: A heartwarming story about young game creators who clash over their project, confront the feelings they have kept inside, and find their way back to the bonds they once shared.

events.title: Rhythmic Gymnastics Club Performance
events.description: A performance themed on Studio Ghibli's masterpiece “Princess Mononoke.” The Rhythmic Gymnastics Club brings the world of Mononoke to life with their signature skills and apparatus.
